title: OPA-Pack: Object-Property-Aware Robotic Bin Packing
abstract: arXiv:2505.13339v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Robotic bin packing is a fundamental manipulation problem with broad applications in e-commerce and warehouse automation. However, existing methods primarily focus on object geometry to optimize packing compactness without explicitly modeling object properties such as fragility, edibility, and chemical compatibility that humans typically consider during packing. This paper presents OPA-Pack (Object-Property-Aware Packing), a framework that incorporates object-property information into robotic bin-packing planning. The framework includes an object property recognition scheme based on retrieval-augmented generation and chain-of-thought reasoning to establish a dataset with object property annotations for 1,032 everyday objects. The framework further incorporates OPA-Net, which encodes candidate-object properties via a property embedding layer and represents the container state using fragility and avoidance heightmaps. translated_title: OPA-Pack：属性感知的机器人装箱
translated_abstract: 机器人装箱是一项基础性的操作问题，在电子商务和仓储自动化领域有着广泛的应用。然而，现有方法主要关注物体几何形状以优化装箱紧凑性，而没有显式建模人类在装箱时通常会考虑的物体属性，例如易碎性、可食性和化学相容性。本文提出了OPA-Pack（属性感知装箱），这是一个将物体属性信息融入机器人装箱规划的框架。该框架包含一种基于检索增强生成和思维链推理的物体属性识别方案，据此建立了包含1,032个日常物体且带有属性标注的数据集。该框架进一步集成了OPA-Net，其通过属性嵌入层对候选物体的属性进行编码，并使用易碎性高度图和避让高度图来表示容器状态。我们设计了一个……
tldr: 提出OPA-Pack框架，利用检索增强生成与思维链推理识别物体的易碎性、可食性和化学相容性等属性，并将其融入机器人装箱规划，实现了更符合人类常识的装箱方案。
